content: Wielding the Trishula with his remaining arm, Kamina channeled the full thermal reserve of his dantian. The three prongs of Shiva's relic erupted in white solar plasma. With a savage, upward 45-degree twist, he sheared through the Demon King's obsidian shoulder joint, severing the arm in a geyser of black synthetic coolant.
critique: Murata: Visceral martial leverage and devastating kinetic payoff.

content: The Trishula's divine resonant frequency synced at 440 megahertz with the Demon's armor lattice. Kamina applied rotational torque against the fulcrum of his impaled sternum, overcoming the 40-megapascal tensile strength of the void alloy to cleanly amputate the limb.
critique: Sanderson: Rigorous structural torque and tensile physics.

content: Kamina didn't just twist the trident; he kicked the Demon King right in his armored crotch while ripping the spear upward! The black arm flew into the air, spinning like a windmill, spraying oily black ichor across the snow as Kamina laughed like an unchained lunatic!
critique: Biga: Street-fight savagery and Mount Hua irreverence.
